title: SUBTRACTIVE SYNTH -- classic mono synth: 2 oscillators, resonant filter, 2 envelopes, LFO

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn on audio with the speaker button, then play the keyboard or a MIDI keyboard.
It is monophonic: the last note held wins.
The menu by the keyboard changes the keyboard mode.
OSCILLATORS: Osc 1 / Osc 2 waveform (Saw, Square, Triangle, Sine).
Detune: shifts Osc 2 by up to +/-25 Hz. Balance: mix of Osc 1 and Osc 2.
Noise: adds white noise. Glide: pitch slide between notes (0-500 ms).
Env Amt: how far the filter envelope opens the cutoff.
AMP ENVELOPE (VCA): Attack / Decay / Sustain / Release of the volume.
FILTER ENVELOPE: Attack / Decay / Sustain / Release of the cutoff.
LFO: Rate (0.05-20 Hz), Depth, and Target (Pitch or Cutoff).
OUTPUT: master level slider with meter.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: ddg.mono picks the note. mtof and line~ turn it into a gliding pitch signal.
Each oscillator runs saw~ / rect~ / tri~ / cycle~ and a selector~ picks one.
The mix goes through lores~, then the amp envelope, then the output slider.
All controls go by send/receive to p synth-engine, which holds the audio chain.
